listNote: Names, descriptions and grades are the official PlayStation text, as listed by Exophase and PSNProfiles (the two agree on every entry). Guides are original writing for this entry; each cites its sources by name and link.

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum pops the moment the other 54 trophies are done — there is nothing extra to do for it. PowerPyx rates the full run 4/10 at roughly 200 hours, while Push Square warns it can run past 300 if you take the 100% checklist slowly. Follow the roadmap in order: story first, side strands as they appear, the 100% haul after the credits, then cleanup.
steps: Finish the story for the 12 story trophies
Clear the six character quest lines and 8 stranger strands
Reach 100% completion for A Long Road
Sweep up the remaining count and secret trophies

steps: Play Chapter 1 to its end
Make a manual save at the start and end of the chapter

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The hardest trophy on the list: reach 100% completion. The checklist (Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion) appears after the story, but progress made before the credits already counts, and nothing on it is missable. Expect it to take most of the roughly 200-hour run. The big items include 70 of the 80 challenges, 15 of the 18 collectible card sets, all 8 bank vaults, all 39 gang operations and gold medals at every shooting range.
steps: Finish the story to unlock the checklist
Work the checklist in the Roadmap's stage 3 order
Check Touch Pad > Progress > 100% Completion to see what is left

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 of the game's 397 stunts: 130 stunt jumps, 202 flights under bridges, 40 knife flights between the Vice City towers and 25 base jumps. You only need a little over half, so skip the ones that fight you. Find discovered stunts at Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots and track progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Activities > Stunts.
steps: Open Touch Pad > Exploration > Stunt Spots to see discovered stunts
Clear the easy jumps and bridge flights first
Leave the fiddly knife flights until last

trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.

trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, across three difficulty tiers, at the two ranges: Rodgers Ranch & Shooting Range in Port Gellhorn and Griffin Shooting Range in Balsero. Work each challenge up through its tiers to gold
Check locked challenges' conditions on the map

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: THE missable one — the only trophy on the list PowerPyx flags as potentially missable. Meditate at all 18 spots in 10 locations, with Jason and Lucia. One meditation is offered only in Chapter 1: Lucia invites you onto her balcony the morning after the mission Down to Earth. Take it when it appears, and keep a manual save from early Chapter 1 as backup. A meditation only counts once its final zen animation has played. Track progress at Touch Pad > Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations.
